column1: # dev-root-causes.tsv — #2306. Per-finding root-cause labels for the DEV clustering data only: the 12 in-repo
# findings files of expected-dev-counts.tsv plus the two #2278 M1 synthetic fixtures. Labelled by hand by the
# #2306 implementer, consistent with the M1 hand counts (every same-block pair of the 12 run files is one root
# cause). file = path relative to dark-factory/; idx = 0-based position in its `verified` list; block = the
# clusterer's block key `file:function` (`-` when the entry has none); rc = root-cause id, compared only WITHIN
# one (file, block). Entries alone in their block get a mechanical unique rc (u<idx>). The held-out oku fixture
# and every held-out candidate contest are NOT in this file. Consumer: bench/corpus-bench/cluster-calibrate.py.
